what_happened: The job was meant to stop requiring the producer to run the full cargo test suite. It did this by recording a new decision that amends D95, updating the design doc and the CHANGELOG [Unreleased] section, and stating the reason with figures from two earlier jobs. It was rejected: 1 of 6 acceptance criteria was unmet and there was 1 major finding. The unmet criterion is the documentation one. It requires decisions.md, the design doc and the CHANGELOG [Unreleased] to no longer say the producer must run the full suite. The major finding is that CHANGELOG [Unreleased] (lines 624-630) still says the producer must run the full suite. No failed checks are listed. The other 5 criteria were met. The decision and design doc edits seem to have been made, and one stale statement was missed.
cause: Nothing checks, before handover, that a change to a rule has reached every place that states the rule. A criterion of the form "no document still says X" is verified only by the verifier at the final verdict, where rejection is the only outcome. The producer edited the places it remembered and did not search the repo for the old wording, and nothing made it do so. The CHANGELOG [Unreleased] section holds several entries about the same rule, so a stale one is easy to miss. This is an inference, since the stored fields do not show what the producer searched.
prevention: Add a pre-handover check to the producer stage. When a criterion says that some wording or rule must no longer appear, the reading must name the phrase, or a pattern for it. The check then searches the listed docs (decisions.md, the design doc, CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased]) for that phrase and blocks handover while any match remains, reporting the file and line. The producer's criterion evidence must cite this search output. That would have caught the leftover CHANGELOG lines 624-630 before the verifier saw them, and it covers every "remove or replace a stated rule" job.
proposed_request: Fix the last unmet criterion of job 20261023-234313-h49d. CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] must no longer say the producer must run the full cargo test suite. Update the entry around lines 624-630 so it matches the new decision that amends D95: the producer is not required to run the full suite, and the reason is the figures from the two jobs (nvbb: six runs against an 1800 s deadline; 9 to 11 minutes per run). Then search docs/decisions.md, docs/design/athena-v0.md and CHANGELOG.md for any other wording that says the producer must run the full suite, and fix every match. Change no other files. Acceptance: a search of those three files finds no statement that the producer must run the full suite, outside the decision's quoted history of D95; and the decision, design doc and CHANGELOG all give the same reason and figures. In the criterion evidence, cite the search command and its output.
